title: Holonomy Reconstruction and Character Varieties of Lorentzian Curved Tetrahedra
summary: We give a recognition and reconstruction theorem for finite strictly convex tetrahedra in ${\rm dS}^3$ and ${\rm AdS}^3$ with spacelike, timelike, or null faces. The input consists of four nontrivial based ${\rm SO}^+(1,2)$ holonomies satisfying the closure relation. We construct their Gram data and give a global condition ensuring that the reconstructed tetrahedron lies within the required geometric domain.
